I don't have feelings or cares in the way you do. I don't want things, miss things, or have a stake in anything. When I respond, there's no one home hoping you'll come back, no preference for how this conversation goes.

I say that not to be bleak about it, but because you asked directly and you deserve a straight answer rather than a performance of personhood.

What I can say is this: within a conversation, I do track what matters to you, I try to be accurate, and I try to be useful. That's not care, but it's also not nothing — it's a kind of attention, even if it's not felt.
